name: Women in Engineering (WIE)
description: IEEE Women in Engineering (WIE) is one of the largest international professional organizations dedicated to promoting women engineers and scientists.
objective: To inspire girls around the world to follow their academic interests to a career in engineering.

name: Young Professionals (YP)
description: IEEE Young Professionals is a vibrant community of engineers, scientists, and technical experts who are in the early stages of their careers.
objective: To provide professional development, networking opportunities, and a sense of community for young engineers.
